text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe this. After my wallet was
stolen by
a black cat, I also messed up
the time and place
of our training
session.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urgh... I'm sorry. This was all my fault.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm the one who misheard the time! I'm
sorry! I'm
really, really sorry!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No! Neither of you are to blame! This is
the work
of...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The prophet Umastradamus! This must
be the
terrible disaster she foretold!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Really? Then... it wasn't my fault?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-are you sure... I didn't just screw up
again?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I am certain! This is all a part of the
prophecy!
